title: Why the Global South will have more leverage than ever in the future of AI
author: Saxon Zvina
authority_note: Opinion piece by a named commentator affiliated with a Belt & Road Initiative think tank; advocacy framing. Factual items (5,000 training, 29-country WAICO, four WAIC proposals) match official announcements, but the piece is not an independent source.
claims: Xi's four WAIC 2026 proposals: openness/win-win, security/controllability, inclusiveness/mutual learning, solidarity/improved global governance
More than 100 UN member states (mostly Global South) have not participated in major international AI governance initiatives
AI adoption could add up to $1.5 trillion to Africa's economy by 2030 (attributed to unnamed 'studies')
China pledged 5,000 AI training opportunities and AI cooperation centers (ASEAN, AU, Arab League, BRICS, SCO, Latin America)
WAICO founded by 29 countries; independent intergovernmental organization per UN Charter principles
Open-source models DeepSeek and Qwen cited as lower-cost options for Global South localization
draft_usage: Cited for the Global South leverage framing and corroboration of WAIC pledges under Social.
issues: Opinion/advocacy source (BRI think tank affiliation); $1.5T Africa figure not independently sourced in-article.
